name: toggle-group
title: Toggle group
description: Independent toggles in one frame; each cell floods from the press point and carries a lamp.
whenToUse: Use it for several independent toggles in one frame, such as text formatting. For one choice of a few use Segmented; for a single toggle use Toggle.

parts.name: ToggleGroup
parts.description: Independent toggles in one frame. Each cell FLOODS yellow from the press point and carries a lamp. A row that does not fit scrolls inside its frame.

props.name: layout
props.description: cell: a cell of an enclosing frame (no own border, cut or background).

parts.name: ToggleGroupItem
parts.description: One toggle of the group: Base UI's Toggle, drawn as Toggle's cell inside the group's frame.
